scope: Current peer DAG only. Primary 45 and selected recovery 16 remain separate.

definitions.root_gold_match: Initial assignee equals predeclared responsibility ID; not output quality.
definitions.cross_worker_completed_runs: At least one non-root task awarded to a worker different from its requester, with execute/synthesize call start/end and succeeded task_end.
definitions.facts_passed: Existing expected.json checks; not proof of complete document quality.
definitions.causality: Observational records do not establish that delegation caused a pass.
